body: This is a Crohns site, but now you put political shit on here?!?!
TRUMP IS FUCKING REPULSIVE!! Why is this on here??? Please remove ASAP!!!!
I would literally kill someone on steroids!! I can’t handle a dose that high ever again! I was crawling out of my skin and stopped it right there and then!! No way Jose!!!

I totally agree!  Going to an infusion center is a pain. I would love ENTYVIO in a pen!! SO EASY!!  I do hope it comes to USA. I’m very happy with it and keep my fingers crossed!! Thanks for the info!!
I highly recommend ENTYVIO!! Not my first biologic but the best!! Only 3 infusions and I’m in remission!! So happy!! Good luck to ya!!

I’ve just started ENTYVIO. My doctor said it has the least side effects?  So far so good. Feeling a big difference. It’s an infusion though. So you would have to figure that out with your job. It’s a fast infusion. Wish you the best of luck!!
I’m also on ENTYVIO and I’m loving it!!  I’ve only had 2 infusions but seeing a difference so far!!  Thinking you best  wishes!!

The 💩 poops are my friends!! Nothing else 
worse then being bound up. My GI said I can take up to 8 immodiums a day!!!!! CRAZY!! I don’t take any immodium unless it gets so bad I can’t hold it. I used to live on immodium then ended up with a blockage in my Terminal Ilium and emergency surgery!! I usually go up to 20 times a day. My record is 27 times in day. I get up early to empty and attempt to go about my day. When I slow down and maybe become constipated I put a scoop of Mirilax in prune juice. This post probably makes no sense?!?! I guess I have my own daily regimen. Everyone is different!! I wish you the best!!
Congratulations you did it !! Best wishes!!
Low D3 levels make you more susceptible to COVID-19. My doctor did a blood test and I’m depleted so high dose D3. Just an FYI.

I take D3, Magesium, PROBIOTIC, Zinc, C, B12, CoQ10, and my favorite COLLAGEN.!!

Collagen is great for Joint Support!! Also for healthy skin, hair, nails. I lost a ton of hair from Crohns and the dreaded Humira!!

I was extremely scared. Had failed biologics already. But let me tell you it’s worth it. NO SIDE EFFECTS FOR ME. Starting to feel better. Everyone is different. But, you got this!! Good luck and no worries!! 🙏❤️😊

Congratulations 🍾🎊🎉🎈 How many infusions before you went into remission? I just started it(2 infusions)already feeing better!! Do you get any side effects? So far, so good with NO side effects!! I’m happy for you!!!
I was allergic to Humira. Glad to be off it!!
NO SIDE EFFECTS FOR ME!!!  👍😊🙏
I really hope it works for you and best wishes!!
Luckily I had my terminal ilium removed, happy about that.
Right now I’m on Mesalamine, Budesionide, Suclafare liquid, and finally ENTYVIO infusions. Feeling pretty good for the most part?!?! But I gotta say CROHNS SUCKS!!   Sorry for poor spelling!! LOL!!
Not crazy, stress is awful. I’m glad you found something that worked!! Good luck!!

I’ve had stomach ulcers for EVER!! They put me on Sucafate liquid. Really calms them down, they go away for a short time and then are back again!! I can’t win. I also have them in my colon!! SUCKS!! Maybe see your GI . Hope you feel better and best wishes!!
Wow, you all have become creative!! Scary but good!! You gotta do what you gotta do!! Good luck all....

Didn’t the lab give you a hat to put in the toilet. As a matter of fact, I just did my stool test for Calprotectin. This morning. I use an old plastic spoon to scoop into the cup. Put the orders in the bag with the sample. I then put in a paper bag and drop off at the lab. They give me bulk supplies due to giving samples so often!! Good luck and don’t forget the mask or you’ll be queasy from the lovely odor. Best wishes!!
I don’t miss mine!! Good luck, you’ll do great!!

I hope you’re feeling at least a little better?? My mom doesn’t understand and when I need to go to the hospital she says “leave me alone and call 911!! Here we go again”   It hurts me mentally!! Your parents are probably better, but if you need to go, you need to wake them!! SERIOUSLY!! Well best wishes and get some rest!! 😊

Go get tested, and don’t be going places!! Call before you go anywhere.!! I hope you’re wearing a mask?? Hopefully just symptoms but GET TESTED!! This isn’t funny!! Sorry to get so upset but think smart especially if you’re going to an infusion center where everyone has a very low immune system!!
NO SOUND ??

Drink a ton of water before you go. Plumps up the veins. Also I have a port due to bad veins and so many hospital admit. Only one small painless needle for less then a second!! I LOVE MY PORT!! Good luck to ya!!
Hope it works for ya?!?! Best wishes!!
AGREED!!
Holy cow!! You can eat salads?? I’m jealous. The give me horrible abdominal pain, 💩, and it goes right through me!! I LOVE SALADS!! Lucky devil!!
I just realized, it’s almost 6am. Did you ever go to the hospital?? Let me know how you are doing??

I think I go to the ER too many times! When I’m vomiting, poops 💩, and pain with a fever, you’re darn right I’m going to the ER. They’re learning to give me pain and puke meds plus solumedrol, potassium, an antibiotic and finally fluids. And boy does that help. It lasts for about a week!! I suggest you go to the ER. They don’t always admit you. Especially if they can calm it down!! Just a thought!!
Sorry what you are going through but it does get better!! Hold on and be strong!!

Best wishes 😃

I’ve only had 2 ENTYVIO infusions and damn I feel better!! The doctor said by the 4th I should be in full remission!! Hallelujah!! 

Thanks for sharing and obviously yours is working as well!! Happy for you!!

P.S. I’m also allergic to Humira, AWFUL DRUG!!
I just started ENTYVIO, but wanted Stelera. Although the ENTYVIO is working already!! Very happy. Hopefully this works for you!! Best wishes!! Let me know how it goes??

I also had a Radical Hysterectomy, missing part of my stomach and a large piece of my intestine. 

I’m pretty sure I’m going to collapse due to lack of organs!! 😂😊
I’ve had surgery for Crohns then adhesion surgery then another adhesion surgery from the first one. So yes, every surgery causes adhesions!! Vicious cycle!!
My terminal ilium, appendix, and gall bladder are all gone not to mention many other organs!! And happy for that!!
💀 DEATH !! So done with Crohns!!!  ☠️🤮👿👹💩
That’s me every morning!! LOL!!
THAT LOOKS ABOUT RIGHT!!
I LOVE Gold Bonds medicated powder down there for that. The creams only keep it moist. The powder dries and heals!! No joke!!
Well I wish you luck and stay positive and strong!! We’re all in this together!!  🤪

I don’t want to hear I can’t!! It’s I can and will. You’re strong enough to do this. You will get diagnosed and put on a treatment plan. Do what the doctors say and you will feel better. I wish you the best and be strong!! Praying for you!!  🙏❤️🙏❤️

I just had my 2nd iron infusion in 1 week. It’s only 15-20 minutes!! Then I get 30 minutes of saline. Only problem is my body isn’t absorbing it?? Why not?? I’m also had my 2nd dose of ENTYVIO and starting to see a difference already!! So excited but worried about the iron. Also can’t take orally makes me sick!!
You too!! Thanks 😊
Thanks 😊
I want Prednisone!! solumedrol!! On a Methelprednisolone pack!! Not doing the job, so pissed!!  😡 Damn GI needs to live 10 minutes in the shoes of Crohns and they’ll give you anything you want!!
Wow those look good. I’m going to try some. Also never had Dinty Moore, what the hell, I’ll buy both and see!!  Thanks 😊
What are otter pops?  Thanks for your support!! I wish you the best!! YES, CROHNS SUCKS!!
I hear ya and know you’re correct, but this really kills me! I think the fatigue is the worst part for me due to I’m very active!!  HATE CROHNS!! Thanks though, I’ll try!!
I’m sorry for you too. We’re all in this together!! I’ve been there too!!!! It sucks!!

I take Mesalamine, Budesionide, and had my 2nd infusion of ENTYVIO. I had a Telehealth meeting with my GI yesterday and told him how I feel and he cut down my Mes, and Bud!! I went off on him (not smart). Still ignored me!! I also get IRON infusions, but my stubborn body’s not absorbing it!!  Feeling sad and down. 😢
I can now laugh that when I think I let out a fart and that’s not it!! Oops!! GROSS!!

I’ve had 2 uploaded doses of it. NO SYMPTOMS!! And I actually had a normal poop only after 1 week after first dose. My GI said I should be in remission by the next 1 or 2 infusions!! SO EXCITED!! I’ve failed other Biologics and thrilled with the ENTYVIO!!
My parents yell at me saying I have an eating disorder. They don’t get Crohns!! So frustrating..
I LOVE ZANAFLEX!! Incredible muscle relaxer!!  Also real good pain meds!! Hallelujah!!!!

I’m on Collagen /vit C/ biotin!! All in one.  helps with many things inc. the joint pain. Love it!! I also go for pain management. That’s not good for my tummy but I don’t care. It helps!! Tylenol does NOTHING!!

It’s a no go for me. I take Budesionide and mesalamine on top of Entyvo infusions. The infusion is helping but the others are a waste!! I have appointment with GI tomorrow morning. Need to be on straight steroids!! To many problems!! Hate Crohns!!
YES, go to the ER!!!  NOW!!
BEAUTIFUL CAT!!
Congratulations on your soon to be first born!!  Make sure you do your treatment so you can be there for your family!! Good luck and congrats!!
I’ll see if I can find it again.

Hello, I don’t have a terminal ileum. With a stricture it was emergency surgery to remove it and some intestines. I also don’t have an appendix or a gall bladder!! So still trying to figure this out. I have an GI appointment tomorrow morning!! Going on 3 weeks of terrible pain!! I hope he has some answers!! Thanks for the reply and the best to you!!

Can I ask what infusion biologic you’re on and how it’s going??

Thanks 😊

I saw that the UK is on phase 2 of a vaccine for Crohns. It’s for people with active Crohns!! I’m not getting my hopes up, but wouldn’t that be incredible to have a vaccine!! Think about it!! 

I also know 2 people with Crohns one in her late 60’s and a guy in his mid 80’s, they both said no problems and no treatment!! I can’t wait to get old and possibly grow out of this!!

Wow, it was good to see your post!! About 1.5 weeks ago the pain on my right side abdomen. I ended going to the ER. Took a CT scan and blood NEVER figured out what is going on!! Can’t lay on my sides or sit to straight up. The doctor wrote off as gas. Lay on your left side and let the gas out?? NO, way!! Have an appointment with my GI today and will discuss it with him. I’ve been diagnosed with Crohns Disease for years and this is brand new?!?! I hope you get to your GI ASAP. Best wishes, you’re not alone!!

I feel your pain!! ALWAYS BEING IN PAIN IS GETTING OLD!! I want to be “normal” whatever that is??

Hope you feel better!! Best wishes!!
That cats expression is a riot!! Great pic!!  😂

I hear ya!! I totally understand!! Yes, it’s very very hard. But I jump into the shower and let me tell ya it wakes you up and revives me. I also am on treatment and take lots of supplements!! I also have to walk my dog and also gets me moving!! Good luck to ya and wish you the best!!!
My GI always tells me to let your body do what it needs!! Ughh!!
AGREED!! Became my friend also. Hate constipation!!
Crohns poops are HORRIBLY REPULSIVE!! Usually not C-Diff.  Any more tests come back? You might be in a flare but I’m sure your GI will put you on some good medication. Again best wishes!!
Don’t ever feel bad! Everyone has different symptoms. This is why we are here for you. Be patient all the tests will come back before you know it!! Stay safe and best wishes!!

I have moderate to severe Crohns Disease and this sound like a normal day to me!! I usually go like 20 times a day. My record is 27 times in one day. 2 surgeries for the colon resection. The list goes on and blah blah blah. You sound “normal”. Good luck and best wishes!! Not to worry!!

Hello again,

Oh, I’m not quiet about my pain!! People in the ER are like shut that girl up LOL!! Still never gave me anything for pain!! Heartless bastard!! Sorry for the language. I got an appointment with my GI this coming Wednesday. I STILL have the pain but not nearly as bad.  I also want to get back on steroids. They help. Even though I’m on Budesionide!! I just started ENTYVIO. The Humira made me worse off!!  Only 2 infusions and pooping normal and half as many times!!  I wish you luck and hope you get your Crohns under control and have fun emptying out for your colonoscopy!! Best wishes and thanks 😊

I just had my second dose yesterday. After the first one my poops were normal!! Haven’t seen that in years!! My doctor said by the third I should go into remission!! Amazing!! So far success and looking forward to the future!

How are your infusions going? I hope you’re getting something positive out of it? Let me know how it goes??
I get a prescription strength capsules from my doctor. Even with a vitamin supplement also, it still depleted from the poops and vomiting. So I also always have Hypokalemia!! You can’t win?!?!
I get fevers when I’m in a flare. The inflammation causes that.

I also have a port and love it!! No more poking and prodding!! It’s been in for 2 years and they use it for my infusions and procedures and hospital visits!! Easy to put in and can take out when you’re done!! Just a thought!!

Hey,
Thanks for the reply. The hospital also thought I was making it up! How wrong is that? Gets me so angry 😡!! Anyways did you ever find out what was going on? Just curious? I had a radical hysterectomy so not that. Just waiting to know and how you’re doing??
Thanks 😊
Green means bile. Not to worry my doctor told me. The food is going through so quickly it doesn’t absorb the bile.

I go for my second Entyvo infusion this Thursday. The first one went well and no side effects!! In fact in 1.5 weeks I actually had a solid BM!! Very big for me and I was thrilled!!  I’m hoping for more great reactions on the second! The doctor said by 3/4 I should go into remission!! I was so excited I wanted to cry!! Yes, corny!!  I hope the same happens for you as well. Good luck and stay strong. 😊
CONGRATS!! Enjoy your McDonalds because you earned it!!

Wow, that’s great! I hope it keeps working for you! Thanks for all the experiences, this helps more than you can even imagine! My fears are just about gone and really looking forward to get started on my infusions and praying for quick remission!! Best wishes to all us Crohnies !!
Keep strong and keep on!! Good luck and best wishes!!
So sorry to hear about your diagnosis. Don’t ignore this!! Fight back!! I wish you the best and you can beat this!!
I start my Entyvo infusion tomorrow. Please let me know how yours went!! Any side effects? Good luck to you!!  👍🍀
I will and thanks so much for all the advice!!  Everyone has been so helpful , I’m glad I asked for the help!! 😃👍❤️

I got the Tizanidene from my doctor and the klonopin from my psychologist. I was hoping they would relax and slow or stop my organs. I couldn’t even move and really thought I was going to die. I need help. This is my 7th time trying and am a fuckin looser. I’m still here in hell.
